card.name: Words before 'Convention' in secession-era text
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'seven', or 'State' just before the word Convention or a similar group noun, mostly in a 1861 secession timeline. Also seen on a few other words before a plural group noun.

modes.label: Secession timeline
